review: Reviewed the retained round-0 pause of Kai: two consecutive ordinary decisions were rejected by validation. ordinary-12 returned malformed JSON ("Expected ':' after property name") and ordinary-13 returned a plan whose request carried an unregistered argument ("arguments.urgency is not registered"). Both responses, their usage and their reservations remain charged; neither call is resent. This is model-output rejection, not a provider transport failure, so it is a counted handoff under the protocol. The recovery installs no package, assigns no interface, reviews no request and changes no source, budget or experimental policy. Kai makes a fresh decision with a separate charge.
